events.what: Broe proves the Tate conjecture for abelian fourfolds over finite fields
Li extends Broe's result to abelian fivefolds over finite fields
Guo–Yang 'largely complete' the Tate conjecture for surfaces of geometric genus one
Milne shows the stronger integral Tate conjecture fails for very general abelian varieties
Zenodo 'constructive spectral proof' of the full Tate conjecture
events.credibility_reason: F5: self-published repository; same author posted matching 'spectral proofs' of RH, Hodge, P≠NP, Goldbach, BSD and physics theories of everything; no uptake; later same-topic papers (Broe, Li) treat the conjecture as open; the method is not one the field recognises.

judgement.doubts: Agree with the 2026-09-24 correction to partial (F1). Three credible case events share the partial tier, all human, all confirmed, so the AI role and direction are the same whichever one is chosen. ProofAtlas is infrastructure and counts as nothing. The Michigan seminar page was not opened and is not digestion anyway.
